Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase! The two umpires make their way out in the middle and the Bangladeshi players follow them. Martin Guptill and Henry Nicholls will open the batting for the Kiwis. Mustafizur Rehman will open the bowling for Bangladesh. 1 slip in place. Here we go...

Right! So, Bangladesh have got a decent score on the board. Can their bowlers defend this total and get them on the level terms in this series? A good start will be on the mind of the Kiwis. So, a mouth-watering chase coming your way in a short while.

The Kiwis bowled well in the first half of the innings where they kept the scoring rate under check. However, they failed to take the wickets regularly. Henry got them the first breakthrough and was superb in his spell, bowling 3 maidens in his 10-over spell. Santer bagged two in his 10. Neesham had a tough outing as he was taken to the cleaners. Jamieson and Boult were economical in their spell too. Towards the end, they gave away 88 in the final 10 overs and would feel that they have given away a few runs too many, especially after having a superb start.

Asked to bat first, Bangladesh started poorly as Das fell for a duck in the 2nd over. Skipper Iqbal and Sarkar got together and added 50-plus calmly. Sarkar was starting to get going but got stumped. Tamim and Tamim and Rahim, Bangladesh's best 2 batters combined and added 48 with Iqbal getting to his half ton. Tamim was looking set for a big one but got run out while trying to steal a single. Mithun walked in and took the attack to the opposition and added a quick 50-plus with Rahim. Rahim got out trying to accelerate but Mithun continued and reached his half ton in quick time. He played a few lusty blows during another 50-plus stand with Mahmudullah. With his unbeaten 73 off 57 balls, Mithun has taken his side to a good total.

Big final over and a fantastic knock from Mithun has taken Bangladesh to a very fine score. An absolute blinder from Mithun. A relatively poor bowling performance from New Zealand as they kept things under control in the first half of the innings but failed to do something similar in the second phase.

FOUR! Finds the boundary on the last ball! Exactly what Bangladesh needed. 12 from the final over! A short one on the body, Mithun pulls it behind square on the leg side for a boundary. BANGLADESH END WITH 271!
Just the single! No boundaries yet in the last over. Full and on off, it is hit down to long off for one.
A yorker outside off, Saifuddin looks to jam it out. It goes off the inner half through mid-wicket for a couple.

DROPPED AGAIN! Boult is the fielder this time! A short one outside off, Mohammed Saifuddin looks to pull but he too mistimes it towards long on. Boult runs to his left, dives and looks to take it but spills it. Two taken.
Safe! Full and outside off, Saifuddin looks to go over covers but mistimes it. It lands safe in that region and two is taken.
Shorter and on middle, this is pulled through mid-wicket for one.
Mohammad Saifuddin is in now.
A single to end! Mithun keeps strike! On middle, it is hit down to long on for one. So despite the biggie, it is a decent over by Boult.
Full and outside off, Mithun looks to jam it out but misses.

OUT! TAKEN! Boult gets his revenge! A short one outside off, Hasan looks to slap it over mid off but fails to get on top of the bounce. It goes high up in the air towards mid off where it is taken with ease by Nicholls.
SIX! Whack! That has gone all the way! Right in the slot. On off and fuller. Hasan smashes it over the long on fence for a biggie.
WIDE! This one is down the leg side. Wided.
A sharp short one, Hasan is beaten for pace as he tries to pull. A dot, gold dust at this stage.
Full toss on off, it is hit towards cover for one.
Hasan looks to pull but ends up getting a nick behind to the keeper on the bounce.
Back of a length and on middle and leg, pulled down to fine leg for a run. 250 up for Bangladesh now.
Full and on middle, Hasan flicks it towards deep mid-wicket. They think for the second but Guptill is quick across the turf.
Short and outside off, pulled down to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Who is in next? Mahedi Hasan it is.

OUT! TAKEN! Mahmuduallah falls. A short ball around off, Mahmudullah goes for the pull but fails to time it as well as he would've liked. The ball goes high in the air towards deep mid-wicket. Guptill settles under it and takes the catch nicely.
Shorter and on middle, it is pulled through mid-wicket for one.

A huge appeal but turned down! New Zealand review! NOT OUT! It has pitched outside leg. Mahmudullah looks to flick but misses. It hits the pad and rolls down to the fine leg fence. The fielder there runs to his right and dives but fails to stop it. New Zealand review more out of hope. The on-field call is the right one and the Kiwis lose a review.
A direct hit and Mithun was in trouble! A low full toss on off, it is driven towards cover. They go for one. Santner has a shy but misses.

PUT DOWN! Mitchell is the culprit! Usually quite safe but this time spills it. A full one on the pads. Mithun whips it but it goes towards deep square leg. Mitchell moves to his right and then looks to take it with a tumble but the ball does not stay in. Two taken. This could prove costly as Mithun is well set and striking it nicely.
Just another single! Shorter and on the body, Mahmudullah pulls but towards deep square leg for one.
Shorter and outside off, this is slapped through covers for one.
Slightly fuller and outside off, Mahmudullah hits it towards cover for one. So dealing in singles in the last 7 balls. New Zealand won't mind that.
On the pads, this is worked through square leg for one. Decent over by Kyle.
WIDE! Slips this one down the leg side, Mahmudullah looks to flick but misses.
One more short one by Kyle, he follows the batter. Mithun mistimes it through mid-wicket for one.
Mahmudullah makes room to access the off side. It is a slower one. Mahmudullahn is early in the shot, it goes off the inner half down towards mid on for one.
Another single as Mithun this time works it through square leg.
A slower dipping full toss on middle, it is worked through square leg for one.
Well done by Conway! On the pads, this is worked fine on the leg side. Conway in the deep, runs to his right, dives and pushes it back in. Saves two for his side.
FOUR! Lovely shot. Mithun on the charge here. Massive over for Bangladesh. Full and just outside off, Mithun makes room and carves it over covers for a boundary. 19 off the over.

NO BALL AND SIX! Half ton for Mithun as well. Poor, poor last ball and Mithun deposits it over the fence. High full toss on the pads, Mithun just helps it over the deep square leg region for a biggie. A gift from Neesham to Mithun and he accepts it nicely to get to the landmark. Free Hit coming up.
Length ball outside off, pushed towards backward point for a quick single.
Full and around off, pushed towards mid off for a quick single.
WIDE! Banged short but it goes well over the batsman. Wided. It was the slower bouncer from Neesham.
Fullish and on middle, played back to the bowler.
Full and around off, hit hard and hit down to long on for a single.
FOUR! Poor ball and Neesham has to pay the price. A low full toss on the pads, Mahmudullah flicks it wide of the man at fine leg for a boundary.
6 overs left. James Neesham is back on. 7-0-42-0 are his numbers so far.
Two more! Short ball on middle, pulled between deep mid-wicket and deep square leg for two. 13 off the over. Expensive finish to an excellent spell from Henry. 10-3-48-1, his numbers.
FOUR! Up and over! This is excellent batting from Rahim. Full and just outside off, Mithun makes room and creams it over mid off for a boundary. He moves to 44 off just 39 balls.
FOUR! Clever from Mithun. A fullish ball on middle, Mithun moves inside the creaese and paddles it over the short fine leg region for a boundary. 200 up for Bangladesh.
Short ball around off, pulled down to deep square leg for a single.
Good length and around off, poked towards the off side for a run.
Fuller and around off, worked on the leg side for a quick single.

Big appeal for LBW but turned down by the umpire. This one lands on the leg stump line and turns away to beat the bat. Mithun gets hit on the pads. They appeal but not out says the umpire. Maybe pitched outside leg.
Short and wide outside off, stroked to deep cover for one.
Mithun makes room outside the off stump. Santner darts it wide outside off, Mithun does well to block it out.
Tossed up and outside off, Rahim looks to play the reverse sweep. Fails to connect.
Flat and on middle, Mahmudullah tucks it through mid-wicket for one.
Floated full and outside off, driven down to long off for one.
Fullish and on middle, tucked towards mid-wicket for an easy run by Mithun.
Back of a length ball on middle, pulled wide of the fine leg fielder for a brace.
Around off, pushed towards Guptill again who misfields but is quick to get up and keep it to a dot.

FIVE WIDES! Bonuns runs for Bangladesh. It was short and down the leg side. Matt rolled his fingers on it. Mithun lets it go down the leg side. Lathan cannot stop it as it goes between his legs and down to the fine leg fence.
Excellent from Guptill. A length ball around off, Mithun pokes it to the left of the point fielder. Guptil dives that side and stops the ball and makes the batter to return.
Fuller and around middle, blocked.
Full and around off, flicked to mid-wicket for nothing.
Matt Henry returns. 5-3-27-1 from him so far.
Flat and around off, kept out. End of successful over from Santner. Just a run and the big wicket of Rahim from it.
Shortish and on middle, flicked to mid-wicket. Mahmudullah wanted the run but is sent back by Mithun.
Full and outside off, poked towards point.
Mahmudullah walks in next.

OUT! TAKEN! Santner strikes and gets the big wicket of Rahim who was starting to find his feet after spening quit some time in the middle. Floated on off and middle, Rahim jumps out of the crease and looks to go big over long on. The man at mid on, Nicholls, does well to get down low and snaffle the chance nicely. Much-needed wicket for the Kiwis.
On off, played back to the bowler.
Tossed up and outside off, driven down to deep cover for an easy run.
Powerplay 3 time! Now, 5 fielders can be outside the 30-yard circle till the end of the innings.

Single to end the 40th over. Full and wide outside off, Mithun drives it through covers for one. The single brings up 50-run stand between the two. 183/3 after 40 overs. 10 more to go. How many more can Bangladesh get in these last 5 overs.
Good length and outside off, Rahim looks to drive but gets an inside edge. The ball goes on the leg side and they sneak a run.
Fullish and around middle, pushed to mid on for nothing.
Back of a length ball on middle, pulled to deep mid-wicket for an easy run.
Outside off, guied to third man for a single.
Short and wide outside off, Rahim cuts it wide of third man. Nicholls there runs to his right and makes an excellent diving save. Two saved.

Just over! Floated outside off, Rahim looks to play the reverse sweep but manages to hit it off the toe end. The ball lobs over the keeper and lands behind him. Short third man gets around. A single to end. Just 2 from the over.
Floated and around off, Rahim defends it out.
Full and outside off, driven to point for nothing.
Shortish and on middle, worked to deep square leg for a single.
Short and wide outside off, Mithun looks to make room and punch. Mistimes it to the man at covers.
Floated on middle and leg, pushed to mid on.
Single to end! Full and outside off, driven to sweeper cover for an easy single.
Short again and Mithun pulls it hard and hits it wide of the man at deep square leg. Two taken before he makes a fine stop to his left. 9 off the over so far.
Short and wide outside off, hit down to deep cover for one more single.
FOUR! Innovation from Rahim now. A fuller ball around off, Rahim moves inside the crease and scoops it over the short third man for a boundary.
Short and wide outside off, pushed towards the covers.
Short ball on middle, Rahim pulls but fails to time it well. Hits it wide of the man at deep mid-wicket for two.
Bowling change. Trent Boult is back on. 6-0-18-0 from him so far.
FOUR! Nicely done! Mithun knew it is going to the fence as soon as he connected the reverse paddle. Tossed up and outside off, Mithin reverse paddles it to find the third man fence.
Tossed up and outside off, eased down to long off for a run.
Shortish and around off, punched to deep cover for an easy run.
On middle, Rahim looks to scoop it over the keeper. Fails to make the proper connection but manages to keep it away from the keeper. A single.
Short and on middle, poked to short third man.
Tossed up and outside off, driven through the covers for a run by Mithun.
Dot to end! 6 dots in the last over of Jamieson against Rahim and now 5 in this over. Fuller ball on middle, Rahim flicks but finds mid-wicket.
And another one! Shortish and just outside off, poked to the man at point.
One more dot. Full and around off, Rahim finds the cover fielder.
Around off on a good length, played back to the bowler.
Good length and around off, dabbed on the off side.
Full and on the pads, Mithun flicks it to fine leg for one.
Around off, punched to the man at point. Dot to end the over.
Short again, punched towards the right side of the backward point fielder for a run.
FOUR! Not off the middle but Mithun will take it. Flat and just outside off, Mithun rocks back and punches it off the outer half. It goes wide of Boult and races to the third man fence.
Mithun makes room by moving on the leg side. Santner follows him. Mithun blocks.
Flat and around off, Mithun blocks it back to the bowler.
Floated around off, pushed towards point.
Mitchell Santner is back on. 5-0-32-1 from him so far.
Make that a maiden over as Rahim finds the point fielder once again. Superb over from Jamieson.
Fuller and on middle, flicked to mid-wicket. 5 dots in the over.
One more dot. A length ball around off, kept out.
Short and just outside off, Rahim makes room, comes down the track and cuts but cannot go past the man at point.
Good length and outside off, poked to point. A big no for the run.
Full and on middle, flicked to mid on for nothing.

SIX! BANG! Take that! What a blow from Mithun. A short ball and on middle. At Neesham's pace, it sits up nicely. Mithun swivels and nails the pull over deep square leg for half a dozen. 150 up for Bangladesh.

On middle, Rahim looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pad. Rahim wants a single but Mithun sends him back. Neesham tries to run the batsman out again with his footwork but this time he fails to hit the stumps.
This one is driven superbly. Full and outside off, Mithun punches the drive through the covers and takes two.
Full and just outside off, driven to mid on for nothing.
Short and wide outside off, guided down to third man for a single.
Fullish and on middle, flicked towards mid-wicket for one.
Once again this is on a length and around off, Rahim drops it towards cover and wants a run but is sent back.
Shorter and on off, Rahim cuts but to point this time.
FOUR! Short ball and put away! Rahim is really good on the cut. There is width on offer outside off, it is cut through point for a boundary.
Shorter and outside off, Mithun guides it down to third man and gets to the other end.
Angled into the pads, this is worked behind square on the leg side for one.
On off, this is guided to point.
Kyle Jamieson is back on.
Full and around middle, worked towards mid on for a quick single by Rahim.
Shortish and outside off, pushed down to third man for a single by Mithun.
Length ball around off, poked towards point for nothing.
A good length ball around off, Mithun blocks it off his front foot.
Who will be the new man in? Mohammad Mithun it is.

DRINKS! New Zealand have got the big wicket of Tamim who was set for a big one here. Superb footwork from Neesham to run him out. Bangladesh now will have to stitch another stand before they can launch themselves towards the death overs. Another wicket quickly and the Kiwis will have them under the pump. The fantastic finish of the innings on the card.

OUT! RUN OUT! Iqbal is well out and some brilliance from Neesham has got the Bangladesh skipper who looked all set for a big score. That is probably the only way he could get out. It is a length ball, Rahim looks to defend but gets an inside edge onto the pads. It rolls beside the stumps. Tamim calls for the run. Neesham though gets to the ball quickly and then kicks it onto the stumps. It is taken upstairs but New Zealand are already celebrating. Replays show that Iqbal is well short.
Iqbal is a goner! He is surely shot but the umpire has taken it upstairs.
On middle, this is worked to mid-wicket.
FOUR! Cracked away! That is some shot. Short and on middle, it sits up to be hit. Iqbal pulls it hard and over the mid-wicket fielder for a boundary.
Almost! This is on the pads, Tamim misses the flick. It hits the thigh pad and the rolls just past the stump.
A slower short ball, Iqbal pulls it again but to mid-wicket.
On middle, it is worked to mid-wicket.
One more single! Shorter and on middle, Rahim pulls but to the man at deep square leg for one.
Well short! Tamim steps out and Henry drags his length back. Iqbal swings. It goes off the top edge but well short of third man for one.
Outside off, this is guided down to third man for one.
Slower one on off, Iqbal works it to mid on.
Good running and good batting! Follows the boundary with a single as this is clipped towards mid on.
FOUR! Up and over! Rahim steps out. Gets to the pitch of the ball and then lofts it over the mid off fielder for a boundary.
Back of a length and on off, Rahim mistimes it to mid on.
Back of a length and on off, Rahim stands tall and plays it onto the ground.
Neesham is back!
Another single! Rahim now nudges it on the leg side and gets to the other end.
Angled into the pads, it is played to mid-wicket.
On middle, defended.
Outside off, this is guided down to third man for one.
BEATEN! Length and angling away from off. Iqbal looks to defend but is beaten.

FOUR! Just wide! Another boundary! Into the 70s is Tamim! This is short and on middle, Tamim looks to flat-bat it but does not get the timing right. It goes uppishly but wide of the fieleder at mid on who puts in a dive and into the fence.
A single to end! Shorter and outsied off, Iqbal guides it through point for one.
Floats it up on the pads, it is worked to short fine leg.
Two now! Outside off, this is guided down towards third man for a couple.
EDGY FOUR! No slip in place and a boundary results! Outside off, slower through the air. Iqbal looks to drive but it goes off the outside edge, past the keeper and into the fence.
On the pads, it is played to mid-wicket again.
On middle, Tamim works it to mid-wicket.
Another one on a length and around off, Rahim defends it out.
Short again, Rahim hops and pulls it towards mid-wicket. A dot.
An expansive drive just for one! Outside off, this is hit through covers. Single.
Swing and a miss! Length and outside off, Iqbal looks to go over covers but misses.
Length again and on middle, Iqbal defends it onto the ground.
Good length and on off, Iqbal drops it towards cover.
Follows the two boundaries with one as this is worked through mid-wicket. A good over for Bangladesh.
FOUR! Deft from Iqbal now! This is brilliant! Santner fires it on off. Iqbal waits, waits and waits. Almost plays it behind his stumps. He guides it down to the third man fence.
FOUR! Brilliant from Tamim! He moves across and Santner fires it on off. Tamim plays the sweep, he hits it over square leg for a boundary.
On off, it is guided to point.
Shorter and on middle, this is pulled over mid-wicket for one.
Fifty for Tamim Iqbal! 50th ODI fifty. A good knock so far, he has played the anchor role but needs to make it count. He gets there by pushing this full ball down to long on for one.

Direct hit and Rahim was a goner! Two in the end! Shorter and on middle, it is worked towards mid on. Rahim goes for it. The fielder picks the ball and has a shy at the bowler's end but misses. The fielders backing up do not stop it cleanly and one more run is taken. Rahim had given up. He was out by a long way.
That is brilliant from Neesham! On off, it is pushed towards cover. Neesham dives to his right and stops it.
WIDE! This is very short. Rahim watches it go to the keeper.
Goes short again, Rahim looks to pull but gets an underedge to backward square leg.
Gets it past mid on somehow! This is shorter and on middle, Rahim pulls, it seems like he is beaten for pace and hence, it goes through mid on. Two.
LEG BYE! Goes full but on the pads, Tamim looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads. It rolls on the leg side. Leg bye taken.
Angled into the middle pole, Tamim works it towards square leg. He wants a run but is sent back.
Turn and bounce! A good nut to end! This lands on off and then spins away. Rahim looks to defend but is beaten.
Shorter and around off, Iqbal pushes it through covers for one.
Outside off, Iqbal guides it to point for another dot.
Well fielded! On middle, Iqbal works it towards mid-wicket. Guptill dives and saves a run. Keeps the pressure on.
Again! Tossed up on off, Iqbal only manages to push it to covers.
On off, it is pushed to covers.
Good tidy stuff from Boult! Hits the bat hard this time. Bends his back, lands it on a length, gets it to bounce extra. It is played towards point.
Another one on a length and angling away. Left alone.
Just outside off, Rahim covers his off pole and leaves it alone.
On a length again, Rahim blocks it out.
Works it with the angle towards mid-wicket and gets to the other end. Tamim moves onto 48.
Good length and on off, defended.
Boult is back on! 4-0-12-0 so far.
Top edge but safe! This lands outside off and then turns back in. Iqbal looks to play the paddle sweep but due to the extra bounce, it goes off the top edge towards short fine leg for one.
Shorter again, Tamim nudges it to square leg.
On middle, this is worked to mid-wicket.
WIDE! Down the leg side, it is left alone.
Fired on off, this is guided to point.
Rahim is off the mark! Outside off, this is pushed through covers for one.
Tossed up on middle, defended.
Rahim walks out to bat!

OUT! STUMPED! Just as the momentum started to shift, Santner strikes. Big blow as Sarkar was starting to get into his element! The slightest of turn does him in. He steps out. It is bowled shorter and on the pads. Sarkar looks to work it on the leg side but the ball turns away, beats the bat and Latham does the rest.
A good short one to end! Tamim looks to pull but misses. A dot to end but back-to-back good overs for Bangladesh.
A single now as this is guided down to the third man region.
Shorter and on middle, Sarkar pulls it towards mid-wicket.
SIX! That is thumped! What a shot! So Sarkar is now getting a move one. He makes room and steps out. It is a length ball and Sarkar lauches it over the long on fence for a biggie.
Shorter and on off, this is pushed to covers.
Shorter and on the body, this is worked through square leg for one.
FOUR! This is put away! Short and just outside off, Sarkar waits for it and then cuts it through backward point. Races away. An expensive first by Santner.
A full toss but just one! Tamim works it through square leg. Should have done better there.
Fired on middle, Iqbal works it to mid-wicket.
Shorter and on middle, it is worked through square leg for one.
This one lands outside off and then turns back in. Hits Sarkar high on the pads. A polite appeal from Santner but nothing.
Well fielded but one taken! On middle, this is pushed to the left of the bowler. Santner moves there, dives but pushes it a little away from the mid-wicket fielder.
Fires one down the leg side. Sarkar leaves it alone. Latham fails to collect it cleanly. One taken.
Santner is on!
Another single! Shorter, it is pulled through square leg.
A single now! On off, it is dropped on the off side for one.
Just over and three! This is full and wide outside off, Sarkar goes after it. Does not quite get it off the middle but it goes over covers. Three taken.
On the pads, it is clipped through square leg just for one. Bangladesh dealing in singles at the moment.
Back of a length and on off, Iqbal plays it late, he gets an underedge to the keeper.
A good short one, it hurries onto the batter. Tamim is late in the pull and is hit on the body.
Back of a length and on off, Sarkar plays it late and towards point. So just the two from the over.
WIDE! Way, way too short. Sarkar makes room and Kyle bangs it in. It goes well over his head. Wided.
A single now! On off, this is pushed down towards mid off for one. Just the one from the over so far.
Back of a length again, Iqbal plays it to point. Another dot.
Back of a length and on off, this is guided to point.
Good length and on off, Iqbal pushes it to covers.
Extra bounce! Shorter and outside off, takes off after landing. Iqbal looks to cut but is beaten.
Dot to end the over. Shortish and just outside off, Sarkar looks to run it down to third man but he ends up guiding it towards the keeper.
Play and a miss! Good length ball just outside off, going away. Sarkar comes down the track and swings hard but misses.
Full and around off, pushed towards mid off this time.
Fuller and on the pads, worked on the leg side for one.

DRINKS! After losing Das early, Bangladesh have done really well so far. While the scoring has been a bit slow, these two now have added 50-plus and are looking good. They will now aim to keep batting as long as they can. New Zealand need to break this stand quickly or else these two will put on a big score together on this beautiful batting deck. Interesting phase coming your way.
Tamim is looking in a bit of trouble and the physio is having a look at him at the moment. The umpires have called for the DRINKS.

Full and on middle, pushed back to the bowler. Neesham quickly picks the ball and throws it at the striker's end to run the batsman out. He ends up hitting the batsman on the back of the arm. That will hurt. It surely will. Tamim is down on the ground. Neesham has a word with him.
MISFIELD AND FOUR! Fuller and on middle, Tamim flicks it nicely and beats the diving mid on fielder and the ball races away to the fence.
Full and on middle, flicked to deep mid-wicket for one. 50-run stand is up between the two.

NOT OUT! The third umpire feels that Jamieson is not in full control of the ball and it has kissed the ground while he is in the act of taking the catch. Jamieson is not a happy man here. He is shocked. That was a stunning grab from the tallest man on the field. A fuller ball around middle, Tamim hits it hard down the ground but Jamieson snaffles it quickly to his left. He celebrates but Tamim stands his ground. The two umpires get together and they refer it upstairs. The soft signal is out. Replays roll in. One angle shows it is a clean catch but the third umpire checks another one and he feels that Jamieson is not in complete control of the ball. It kissed the turf as he landed. The soft signal will be overturned here. Not out shows the big screen on the ground and Jamieson is not happy with the verdict one bit.

Has Jamieson taken a blinder? Tamim is not sure so he stands his ground. The soft signal is out. Well, well, Jamieson has taken the catch but he gets down, the ball kisses the turf. He is in the act of taking the catch while the ball gets in contact with the ground.
Good length ball just around off, poked towards the cover fielder.
Around off on a good length, blocked.

In the air... dropped. That was an excellent effort and would've been a stunning catch. A fuller ball on middle and leg, Sarkar flicks it uppishly towards deep mid-wicket. Nicholls from deep mid-wicket runs to his left and dives full length. The ball hits his hand but doesn't stuck.
Full and on middle, Tamim flicks it through mid-wicket. Deep square leg gets around to his right with a slide. Three taken and it brings up 50 for Bangladesh.
Good comeback from Neesham. This is on a good length and just outside off. Hint of away movement as this beats the outside edge.

FOUR! Pulled away! Superb shot from Sarkar. Second boundary in the over. Neesham bangs it short and on middle but at Neesham's pace, it is easy pickings. Sarkar swivels and nails the pull wide of the fine leg fielder. The ball goes to the fence.
Shortish and outside off, pushed to short third man.
Short and around off, pulled to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Around off, kept out.
FOUR! Crunched through the covers. Shortish and outside off, the Bangladeshi skipper flays it through the covers. Young gives it a chase but fails to stop.
Lovely yorker to end the over! It is just outside off. Sarkar looks to dig it out but missses.
Full and down the leg side. Flicked uppishly towards fine leg for one.
Length and around off, pushed on the leg side for a quick single.
Wide outside off on a good length, punched towards the cover fielder.
Jamieson runs in to bowl but Sarkar moves away as the last moment. Sarkar feels there is some issue with his willow. New bats are out. Sarkar selects one and we are ready again.
Full and outside off, driven to mid off.
Length ball angling away from the left-hander. Left alone.
Dot to end the over! Length and outside off, kept out.
Good length and outside off, pushed towards point for nothing.
WIDE! Neesham bangs it short but it goes well over the batsman. Wided.
Short and outside off, Tamim comes down the track and looks to hammer it on the leg side but mistimes it towards mid on.
Good length and around off, kept out.
Full and wide outside off, poked down to third man for a run.
Full and around middle, flicked wide of the man at mid on for one.
WIDE! Neesham starts with one down the leg side. Tamim looks to flick but misses. Given wide.
James Neesham is into the attack now.
Short ball on middle, pulled to fine leg for one. 8 off the over.
Shortish and just outside off, pushed towards the off side.
Full and wide outside off, driven to the man at covers.
Around off on a length, worked on the leg side.

Misfield and three. A fuller ball again. Sarkar strokes it to the left of the mid off fielder who dives that side but fails to stop. The ball goes towards the fence. The fielder chases it down before it gets to the ropes. Three taken.
FOUR! Driven on the up and driven nicely! First boundary for Sarkar. A fuller ball outside off, Sarkar nails the drive past the mid off fielder. No chance for him to stop that one.
Powerplay 2 time! Maximum of 4 fielders can be outside the 30-yard circle.
Another maiden from Henry. Good length and around off, tucked towards square leg for nothing. 26 for 1 in the Powerplay 1. Perfect start for the Kiwis.
Fullish and outside off, left alone.
Length and around off, defended back to the bowler
Full and around off, pushed on the leg side.
On off, Tamim is solid in defense.
Good length and just outside off, pushed towards the point region.
Yes! He can and he does that. Full and outside off, Sarkar looks to drive but the ball hits the toe end and goes to mid off. Perfect start for Kyle.
Shortish and around off, poked towards point. 5 dots so far. Can Jamieson start his spell with a maiden?
Length ball around off, played back to the bowler this time.
Around off on a length, worked on the leg side.

Beaten! Good carry to the keeper. Lovelt bowling from Jamieson. This one is on good length and just outside off, it leaves the batter. Sarkar looks to force it on the off side but misses. The ball goes behind and the keeper collects in front of his face.
Appeal for LBW straightaway but looked to be going down. A fuller ball the pads, Sarkar looks to flick but misses to get struck on the pad. An appeal but turned down.
Kyle Jamieson is on now.
FOUR! Creamed through cover-point. Big over for Bangladesh. Third boundary in the over. Full and wide outside off, Tamim nails the drive through cover-point to bag another boundary.
Length ball around off, kept out.

FOUR! Up and away again. Henry bangs this one short. Tamim goes for the pull. Fails to middle it but hits it just wide of the man at short mid-wicket. Neesham leaped to his left but failed to get there.
Around off on a good length, Tamim is right behind the line of the ball to block.

FOUR! Runs off Henry this time. A little too full and too straight from him and Tamim is not going to miss out. He flicks it through mid-wicket. It was uppish but in the gap. Races away to the deep mid-wicket fence.
Full and outside off, driven to the cover region. 18th dot off Henry's spell so far.
Short again, Tamim pulls it down to fine leg. A single to end the over.
Fullish and on middle, pushed to mid on.
Banged short and on middle, Tamim ducks.
Only one slip now. Two catchers on the leg side. One at square leg and one at short mid-wicket.
Around off on a length, played back to the bowler.
Full and down the leg side. Flicked to fine leg for a run.
Good length and around off, it moves away after pitching. Tamim pokes it down to third man for a single.
Little wide outside off, Sarkar lets it go to the keeper.

Huge appeal for LBW but turned down. A fuller ball on the pads, Sarkar looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pad. A big appeal follows but not out says the umpire. Maybe going down the leg side and hence Latham and Henry are not keen about reviewing it.
Back of a length ball around off, poked towards the point region.
Play and a miss! Matt bangs it short and just outside off, Sarkar looks to pull but misses.
Full and outside off, driven nicely but straight to the cover fielder.
Length ball around off, worked on the leg side for nothing.

NOT OUT! Nothing on Ultra Edge so the technology saves Tamim. A length ball slipped down the leg side. Tamim looks to flick but misses. The keeper dives to his right and takes the catch. They go up in appeal but the umpire is not interested. However, he raises his finger after a while. Tamim reviews immidiately. Replays confirm why. The ball came off the pad and the Ball Tracker confirm the same. Excellent use of the DRS from the Bangladesh skipper.

Tamim has been give out. He has gone for the review straightaway. It was a really late call from the onfield umpire. Looks like the ball has hit the pad on its way to the keeper. Ball Tracker confirms the same. The onfield verdict will be changed.
A bit too full from Boult and it is outside off. Tamiq drives it gently through the covers and by the time the fielder chases it, Tamim gets two more.
Fullish and around off, Tamim takes a step or two forward and pushes it to mid off. He is looking really solid in the middle.
Sharp bouncer! Sarkar somehow manages to pull it towards mid-wicket and take a single to open his account.
Fullish and around off, Sarkar allows the ball to come to him and then defends it towards the cover region. Good adjustment from him.
Length ball around off, Sarkar pushes it towards point.
Bouncer to end the over. Tamim sits under it. Just 2 from the 4th over.
Fullish and around off, Tamim looks to drive but the ball takes the inside half and goes to mid-wicket.
Around off on a good length, poked back to the bowler this time.
Shortish and just outside off, Tamim gets top of the boucne and pushes it towards backward point.
Full and wide outside off, Tamim drives it. Fails to time it as well as he would've liked but gets a brace.
Good length and around middle and leg. Tamim looks to flick but misses to get hit high on the pad.
Dot to end the over. Another tight one from Boult. 2 off it. The last ball is slightly on the shorter side. It is pushed towards backward point.

Tight again from Boult and he goes past the outside edge again. Good length and just around off, Sarkar stays rooted to his crease and looks to defend. The ball leaves him a touch to beat the outside edge.

Loose shot from Sarkar. A fullish ball outside off, it shapes further away. Sarkar goes for the booming drive on the off side. Misses to connect. He has faced 3 balls so far and has been beaten on all the three occasion.
Quick single! Fullish ball around middle, it is pushed a little wide of the man at mid on and they sneak a quick run.
WIDE! Slips this one down the leg side. Tamim misses his flick. Wided.
Good length and just outside off, poked towards point for nothing.
Good length and around off, Tamim is solid in defense on the off side.

Almost gets him this time. Sarkar is lucky not to edge it behind. A perfect first over from Henry. A wicket maiden. This one is slightly on the shorter side. It lands on off and middle and goes away. Sarkar pokes at it to get beaten.
Beaten first ball. Lovely from Henry. A length ball just outside off, Sarkar feels for it away from his body. Gets beaten for the outside edge.
Soumya Sarkar makes his way out in the middle. He was dismissed for 3-ball duck in the first game.

OUT! TAKEN! Henry strikes and Das is on his way for a 4-ball duck. A short ball from Henry. It hurries on Das who looks to pull but ends up hitting it off the top half of his bat. The ball goes uppishly towards Young at square leg who does well to snaffle the low chance nicely. Early success for Henry and New Zealand here.
Back of a length and around off, Das blocks it on the leg side.
Length ball around off, this one is worked towards mid-wicket. Tamim thought for a run but Das said no.
Henry starts with a very full ball around off, Das strokes it firmly straight down the ground but Henry stops it in his followthrough.
Matt Henry will partner Trent Boult from the other end.
Shortish and just outside off, Tamim pokes it towards backward point. Nice first over from Boult. Good, solid stuff with the bat from Tamim too.
Fuller and on the pads again, it was the slower one. Tamim is early in the flick as he misses it to get hit on the pad.
FOUR! Uppish but wide and away to the fence. Nice positive start from Tamim. A fullish ball on the pads of Tamim. He flicks it over square leg and finds the fence in the deep.
Bangs it short and around off and middle, Tamim sits under it.
Slightly fullish this time and it is around off, Tamim pushes it towards mid on. Nicely on the front foot and then a solid push.
Boult is right on the money! A length ball around off, Tamim gets on the front foot and blocks it nicely.

Right! We are done and dusted with all the pre-game formalities. It is time for the action in the middle. The Kiwi players are out in the field. Tamim Iqbal and Liton Das will open the batting for Bangladesh. Trent Boult is ready with ball. Two slips in place. All set now. Here we go...

Tasking Ahmed chats now. Taskin says that it is important to bowl in right areas in New Zealnd. Feels that the conditions here are good for both, batters as well as bowlers. Tells that playing New Zealand in New Zealand is always tough. Thinks that if you execute your plans well, you can get good results. Adds that the wickets in Bangladesh are slow and low. Ends by saying that they are looking forward to bowl on wickets like these.

Pitch Report - Craig McMillan and Mark Richardson are in for the pitch report. McMillan tells that the sun is out and it is looking a perfect day for cricket. Tells that there is no real green grass on this wicket but feels the pacers will get bounce. Richardson feels that Bangladesh needs to use the crease better. Adds that plenty of runs on offer but Bangladesh will have to bat a lot better than the first ODI.

Henry Nicholls is caught for a quick chat. Start by saying that the series has started really well for them. Adds that their aim was to do that but the way they did it was amazing. Says that it is a new ground so terms it as a new challenge. Tells that they are used to changing formats. Adds that he is really enjoying the new role at the top of the batting order. Says that this ground is special and hopes to have a great game with a decent crowd.

Bangladesh (Playing XI) - Tamim Iqbal (C), Liton Das, Soumya Sarkar, Mushfiqur Rahim (WK), Mohammad Mithun, Mahmudullah, Mehidy Hasan, Mahedi Hasan, Taskin Ahmed, Mohammad Saifuddin (IN FOR HASAN MAHMUD), Mustafizur Rahman.

Tamim Iqbal, the Bangladesh skipper, tells that they take a lot of pride in their batting and feel they didn't bat well at all in the first game. Tells that it looks like a good wicket. Wants to have a good start. Reckons that the ODI wickets in New Zealand are always good. On wickets, Tamim feels that whether it is a flat track or a moving track, you need to bat well. Informs that they have one change as Mahmud got injured in the last game and he misses out and Saifuddin replaces him.

New Zealand (Unchanged Playing XI) - Martin Guptill, Henry Nicholls, Devon Conway, Will Young, Tom Latham (WK/C), James Neesham, Daryl Mitchell, Mitchell Santner, Kyle Jamieson, Matt Henry, Trent Boult.

Tom Latham, the Kiwi skipper, says that they want to make early inroads in this game and then chase the total down under lights. Informs that they are playing the same XI. Feels they set the tone nicely in the first game and hopes to do the same here as well. Adds that playing at home is always special.
Toss - New Zealand skipper Tom Latham and Bangladesh skipper Tamim Iqbal are out in the middle for the toss. Up it goes and it lands in favor of New Zealand. They will BOWL FIRST.

Hello and welcome to match no. 2 between New Zealand and Bangladesh. The first ODI ended how most of the people, probably everyone except the visitors’ optimistic fans, expected it to. It was a thumping win for the Kiwis and the same is expected in this game. For Bangladesh, this is a must-win encounter if they are to remain alive in the series. The hosts, on the other hand, will want to seal the series here itself. Will we see a better display from the visitors or will they be blown away once again? Toss and team news coming up shortly.
